           switcher in js/accessibility.js settles the rest, but on inner
           pages it does not run until the end of the body and inside the
           release frame it is a separate download - either way the reader
           would otherwise watch a light page turn dark in front of them. */
        (function (d) {
            var t = "";
            try {
                t = window.localStorage.getItem("pibStyle") || "";
            } catch (e) {
                t = "";
            }
            if (t === "orange") {
                t = "yellow";
            }
            var c = t === "change" ? " pib-hc"
                : t === "green" ? " pib-theme-green"
                : t === "yellow" ? " pib-theme-yellow" : "";
            if (c) {
                d.documentElement.className += c;
            }
        }(document));

    <script type="text/javascript">
        function setDropdownState(dropdown, isOpen) {
            if (!dropdown) return;

            var content = dropdown.querySelector(".dropdown-content");
            var btn = dropdown.querySelector(".theme-toggle");
            var menuLinks = dropdown.querySelectorAll(".dropdown-content a");

            if (isOpen) {
                if (content) {
                    content.style.display = "block";
                    content.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "false");
                }
                if (btn) btn.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "true");
                menuLinks.forEach(function (link) { link.setAttribute("tabindex", "0"); });
            } else {
                dropdown.classList.remove("open");
                dropdown.classList.remove("sfHover");
                if (content) {
                    content.style.display = "none";
                    content.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
                }
                if (btn) btn.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false");
                menuLinks.forEach(function (link) { link.setAttribute("tabindex", "-1"); });
            }
        }

        function closeAllDropdowns() {
            var dropdowns = document.querySelectorAll(".dropdown");
            dropdowns.forEach(function (d) { setDropdownState(d, false); });
        }

        document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
            closeAllDropdowns();

            var toggles = document.querySelectorAll(".theme-toggle");

            toggles.forEach(function (toggle) {
                toggle.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    e.stopPropagation();

                    var dropdown = toggle.closest(".dropdown");
                    var wasOpen = toggle.getAttribute("aria-expanded") === "true";

                    closeAllDropdowns();
                    if (!wasOpen) {
                        setDropdownState(dropdown, true);
                    }
                });

                toggle.addEventListener("keydown", function (e) {
                    if (e.key === "Enter" || e.key === " " || e.key === "Spacebar") {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        e.stopPropagation();
                        toggle.click();
                    } else if (e.key === "Escape" || e.key === "Esc") {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        closeAllDropdowns();
                        toggle.focus();
                    }
                });
            });

            var menuButtons = document.querySelectorAll(".dropdown-content a[role='button']");
            menuButtons.forEach(function (btn) {
                btn.addEventListener("keydown", function (e) {
                    if (e.key === " " || e.key === "Spacebar") {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        btn.click();
                    }
                });
            });

            document.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
                if (!e.target.closest(".dropdown")) {
                    closeAllDropdowns();
                }
            });

            document.addEventListener("keydown", function (e) {
                if (e.key === "Escape" || e.key === "Esc") {
                    var openBtn = document.querySelector(".theme-toggle[aria-expanded='true']");
                    closeAllDropdowns();
                    if (openBtn) openBtn.focus();
                }
            });
        });
    </script>
</div>

<script type="text/javascript">
    /* Header search. The masters already wrap the page in a server-side
       <form>, so this cannot be a form of its own; Enter and the button
       both navigate to the search page instead. */
    (function () {
        var input = document.getElementById("Bar1_q");
        var go = document.getElementById("Bar1_go");
        if (!input || !go) { return; }

        var target = "/AdvanceSearch.aspx";

        function submitSearch() {
            var q = (input.value || "").trim();
            if (!q) { input.focus(); return; }
            /* Region and language are carried on the query string sitewide,
               so the search page must stay in the reader's locale. */
            var params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
            var extra = "";
            if (params.get("reg")) { extra += "&reg=" + encodeURIComponent(params.get("reg")); }
            if (params.get("lang")) { extra += "&lang=" + encodeURIComponent(params.get("lang")); }
            window.location.href = target + "?q=" + encodeURIComponent(q) + extra;
        }

        go.addEventListener("click", submitSearch);
        input.addEventListener("keydown", function (e) {
            if (e.key === "Enter" || e.keyCode === 13) {
                e.preventDefault();
                submitSearch();
            }
        });
    }());
</script>

<script type="text/javascript">
    // Guard variable to ensure this script never runs twice even if cloned
    if (!window.topMenuAccessibilityInitialized) {
        window.topMenuAccessibilityInitialized = true;

        function initializeTopMenuAccessibility() {
            var allMenuItems = document.querySelectorAll('.sf-menu li.has-sub');
            var menuItems = [];

            // Scope to the desktop nav only
            for (var i = 0; i < allMenuItems.length; i++) {
                if (!allMenuItems[i].closest('.mean-nav') && !allMenuItems[i].closest('.mean-container')) {
                    menuItems.push(allMenuItems[i]);
                }
            }

            menuItems.forEach(function (menuItem) {
                var trigger = menuItem.querySelector('a');
                var submenu = menuItem.querySelector('ul');
                if (!trigger || !submenu) return;

                // Setup ARIA attributes
                trigger.setAttribute('role', 'button');
                trigger.setAttribute('aria-haspopup', 'true');
                trigger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');

                if (!trigger.getAttribute('aria-label')) {
                    var linkText = (trigger.textContent || '').trim();
                    if (linkText.length > 0) trigger.setAttribute('aria-label', linkText);
                }

                // Sync ARIA expanded state with Superfish's 'sfHover' class
                if (typeof MutationObserver !== 'undefined') {
                    var observer = new MutationObserver(function (mutations) {
                        mutations.forEach(function (mutation) {
                            if (mutation.attributeName === 'class') {
                                var isExpanded = menuItem.classList.contains('sfHover');
                                trigger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', isExpanded ? 'true' : 'false');
                            }
                        });
                    });
                    observer.observe(menuItem, { attributes: true });
                }

                // Keyboard navigation (Enter / Space to open/close)
                trigger.addEventListener('keydown', function (event) {
                    if (event.key === ' ' || event.key === 'Spacebar' || event.key === 'Enter') {
                        if (trigger.getAttribute('href') === '#') {
                            event.preventDefault();
                        }
                        event.stopImmediatePropagation();

                        // Use Superfish's native methods so it doesn't break hover
                        if (menuItem.classList.contains('sfHover')) {
                            if (typeof jQuery !== 'undefined') jQuery(menuItem).superfish('hide');
                        } else {
                            if (typeof jQuery !== 'undefined') jQuery(menuItem).superfish('show');
                        }
                    }

                    if (event.key === 'Escape') {
                        event.preventDefault();
                        if (typeof jQuery !== 'undefined') jQuery(menuItem).superfish('hide');
                        trigger.focus();
                    }
                });
            });

            // Close on Escape anywhere
            document.addEventListener('keydown', function (event) {
                if (event.key === 'Escape') {
                    if (typeof jQuery !== 'undefined') jQuery(menuItems).superfish('hide');
                }
            });
        }

        if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
            document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', initializeTopMenuAccessibility);
        } else {
            initializeTopMenuAccessibility();
        }
    }





    /* An "Advance Search" button was injected here into the meanmenu
       bar on small screens. Two reasons it is gone:

       1. It was the fourth entry point to the same search page. The
          nav item was removed in TopMenu.ascx.cs, and DBIM 3.0 sections
          5.4 and 9(v) put a real search field in the header instead -
          see Usercontrol/Accessibility.ascx. That field and its
          "Advanced search" link sit outside .pull-left, so they are
          present on small screens too.

       2. It did not run. The markup string carried loading="lazy" with
          double quotes inside a double-quoted JavaScript string, which
          closed the literal early and made the whole block a syntax
          error. Because it sat in this same <script> element, it took
          the menu ARIA and keyboard handling above down with it on
          every page that renders this control. */
</script>

<style type="text/css">
    .nbs-flexisel-nav-left:before {
        content: '\2B9C'; /* Unicode for leftwards arrow */
    }


    .nbs-flexisel-nav-right:before {
        content: '\2B9E'; /* Unicode for rightwards arrow */
    }

    .nbs-flexisel-nav-right {
	right:3px;
        /*right: -22px;*/
    }

    .nbs-flexisel-nav-left {
	left:4px;
       /* left: -22px;*/
    }

    .nbs-flexisel-nav-left, .nbs-flexisel-nav-right {
        /*padding: 3px 22px;*/
        top: 23%;
        /* was #bf0000 - a red that is in no DBIM 2.1 group. Key colour on
           the white chip measures 8.33:1. */
        color: var(--dbim-key, #0F5757);
        font-size: 230%;
	background: var(--dbim-inclusive, #FFFFFF);
    }

        /* The arrow above is a TEXT CHARACTER (B9C / B9E). DBIM 3.7(ii)
           permits PNG, WEBP or SVG only, so it cannot stay one. The script
           at the foot of this file swaps in the sprite's chevron and adds
           .pib-nav-svg, which turns the character off. If that script does
           not run - or the sprite is missing - the character remains and the
           control is still visible, rather than an empty white box. */
        .nbs-flexisel-nav-left.pib-nav-svg:before,
        .nbs-flexisel-nav-right.pib-nav-svg:before {
            content: none;
        }

        .nbs-flexisel-nav-left:focus,
        .nbs-flexisel-nav-right:focus {
            outline: 2px solid var(--dbim-key, #0F5757);
            outline-offset: 2px;
        }

    .nbs-flexisel-item img:focus::after {
        outline: 2px solid black;
    }

    .pp-icon-btn {
        background-color: var(--dbim-key, #0F5757);
        color: var(--dbim-inclusive, #FFFFFF); /* 8.33:1 on the key ground */
        border: 1px solid var(--dbim-key, #0F5757);
        width: 35px; /* Fixed width */
        height: 35px; /* Fixed height */
        border-radius: 4px; /* Slight curve */
        cursor: pointer;
        font-size: 16px;
        line-height: 1;
        padding: 0;
        display: inline-flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
        transition: background 0.2s;
    }

        .pp-icon-btn:hover, .pp-icon-btn:focus {
            /* Pale ground with a key glyph, the same hover the consent
               buttons use. `color` has to move with the background: the
               glyph is an inline SVG on currentColor and a white one on a
               pale ground would disappear. 7.11:1. */
            background-color: var(--dbim-pale, #D9F2F2);
            color: var(--dbim-key, #0F5757);
            border-color: var(--dbim-key, #0F5757);
            outline: 2px solid var(--dbim-key, #0F5757);
        }
    /* Pause Bars */
</style>
